base_model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; vision tower loaded, frozen, unused)
method: low-rank adapters on every nn.Linear of the text backbone (186 modules), r=32, alpha=64, base weights frozen in bf16; adapters merged into the weights before saving

data.source: 4,000 texts sampled from the Mia train split (负面 1,400 / 正面 1,400 / 中性 1,200), 6-200 characters
data.labels: one LLM, JSON-schema-constrained output, 25 texts per request

input: chat template, thinking off; user: 摘出下面文本中承载态度的依据词，并判断表达模式，只输出 JSON。\n文本：{text}\n整体态度：{sentiment}
loss: cross-entropy on target tokens only; lm_head applied only at target positions (248k vocabulary)
optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 0, 5% warmup + cosine, grad clip 1.0
